Pain Tolerance.name: Pain Tolerance
Pain Tolerance.description:
🩹 You keep functioning through injuries that would drop most people.

⚠️ It heals nothing: injuries you ignore still get worse.
📋 Requires level 16 and Conditioning 15.

📈 Grants: Health +15
Pain Tolerance.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has been hurt often enough to work through pain: they stay conscious, keep moving and think clearly through bruises, burns and cracked ribs. Show it as grim focus and injuries noticed only after the fight. Limits: tolerance heals nothing; ignored injuries get worse, Recovery Girl or a hospital doctor will still order rest, and a hard blow to the head still knocks them out.
